description: Defines a Flutter widget named FadeAnimation that combines fading and sliding animations using the simple_animations package.

classes.name: FadeAnimation
classes.description: A widget that applies a fade-in and slide-up animation to its child, replacing older simple_animations API with v5 API.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree, creating a MovieTween for opacity and translateY, then uses PlayAnimationBuilder to animate the child widget.
